After Effects

Exports a ZIP with a script that builds the comp in After Effects: File > Scripts > Run Script File, then choose “Build S4C Motion vector comp.jsx” in the unzipped folder. The logo becomes shape layers, one per letter, with the app's exact curl and flat-at-rest motion and a "Logo window" mask. In the Cromlin the strip, its gradient, keyframes and depth of field are built too.

Settings

Copies every current setting from both the Logo and Cromlin sections as text, so it can be pasted into a chat and made the app's default.
Paste text from Copy settings to restore it. Text with only Logo settings changes just the Logo section.
